# $crav1-ideas-to-spec

lane: specify | group: Start | starter: yes | stage: stable | since: 1.0.0 | prompts: 2
purpose: Turn a free-form pile of ideas (and any technical hunches in the same text) into a spec, diagrams, ADRs, and a chosen export format.
use_when: A pile of ideas and hunches
reads: Reads one unstructured pile and the repo.
writes: Writes `spec.md`, `diagrams.md`, slice ADRs, the chosen `export/`, optional `notes.md`, the same landscape or index-and-glossary result as spark, and `work-item.md` on an Azure Repos opt-in. Where it reads a whole repo, sets that repo's `Synced at` line in `repos.md` and touches only those repos. Where it reads only one slice, leaves the repos.md Synced at lines alone and writes or updates `Synced at: <repo> <branch>@<short sha>, <date>` on that slice's `spec.md`.
leaves alone: Leaves application code and the rest of an existing landscape alone.
limits: two or more v0 slices or repos writes nothing and points at `$crav1-bundle-to-specs`. A quoted note in `docs/notes/` gets its slug in `used_by` and a `Full source:` link; notes are never absorbed.
flow:
- Idea pile + technical hunches → thin `docs/system/` when missing, including `glossary.md`, then spec, diagrams, ADRs, chosen export, then one index row.
- A missing `glossary.md` is filled.
- A meaning the source does not state is `to be researched`.
- On Azure Repos, offers once to write `work-item.md`.
called_by: Called by the user.
runs by itself: Calls `$crav1-create-feature-branch` when the repo already has commits.
you run next: $crav1-create-feature-branch; $crav1-review-architecture; $crav1-tighten-spec
first: `$crav1-ideas-to-spec <paste the pile in your own words. Mix product ideas and technical thoughts. You can mention an export format in the same text (EARS, BDD, OpenSpec, YAML, JSON, BMAD) or skip it and the skill will ask.> Treat hunches as proposed, not decided. Do not write code. Capture first, then architecture questions.`
walkthrough: from-ideas.md
human: https://github.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/blob/v1.208.0/docs/reference/skills/crav1-ideas-to-spec.md
